excerpts.text: # Personal and Companion Care  Morris County,   New Jersey Team

When your loved one needs a little extra help to live at home safely, BAYADA’s home care services make life a bit easier. Our trained and compassionate caregivers lend a hand with daily routines like bathing, dressing, meal prep, and light housekeeping—and bring friendly companionship so your loved one never feels alone.

Your family is supported by a local office team and a nurse manager who develops, monitors, and updates your loved one’s care plan should needs change. You’ll also have 24/7 access to an on-call professional who’s always available for questions or concerns. You'll enjoy a personalized plan and schedule that fits your loved one’s needs and preferences, combining trusted companionship services and personal care with genuine peace of mind.

A friendly team member will talk with you about what type of daily support is needed (eg, bathing, grooming, meal prep, companionship), as well as your living arrangements, preferences, and schedule. They will ensure you live within our service area, explain payment options, and discuss next steps.
